{{Quote|No, I ''do'' trust you, but ''Verhandle'' is one of the shadiest characters ''I've'' ever met. Start bargaining with him, and before you know it you'll be giving up everything you own. And you'll think it was ''your'' idea.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="art" />}}
At one point, [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] traveled to a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Their '''mission''' was to deliver cargo items to Solo's friend [[Verhandle]]. Verhandle wanted to pay Solo only seven-five percent of their agreed upon fee for the cargo items, which did not suit well for Solo. When Verhandle lowered it to sixty percent, Solo agreed and gave his friend the cargo. Unbeknownst to Solo and Chewbacca, a group of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] working for Verhandle entered Solo's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], to commandeer it. When Solo and Chewbacca departed the planet, the soldiers revealed themselves, only to be defeated by Chewbacca.
